ruleDefinitions.name: App Granted Microsoft Permissions
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an application is granted delegated or app role permissions for Microsoft Graph, Exchange, Sharepoint, or Azure AD Note: Unmapped fields: properties.message

sequences.query: (properties.message = "Add\ delegated\ permission\ grant" OR properties.message = "Add\ app\ role\ assignment\ to\ service\ principal")
